newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent futures seen range trading after fall.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent futures seen range trading after fall.

text.p: NEARBY MONTH CLOSE * SUPPORT * RESIST * RSI-14 * MA-10 * MA-20
----------------- VIEWS FROM THE MARKET - JUNE 25 -------------
+ IPE Brent was expected to range trade on Wednesday as a push
to the upside
failed on Tuesday.
+ Resistance for August Brent was seen around the $18.00 level
and then
$18.14 with Tuesday's high. Support at $17.70
+ Gas oil also stuck in range with resistance around $162.00
and support at
$158.00 a tonne.
IPE Brent futures were expected
to range trade on Wednesday having posted modest losses on bearish supply fundamentals on Tuesday, traders said.
August Brent settled 11 cents lower at $17.87 a barrel on Tuesday and was trading -12 cents at $17.72 at 08.50 GMT, while gas oil ended unchanged at $160.25 a tonne.
"Some more of the same old range-trading choppiness lies directly ahead," Al Graham at Elliott Wave International in Gainesville, Georgia said in his energy outlook.
"My short term subjective preference is for price to advance to near or a little above $18.32, and then commence the fall to under $17.49," said Graham.
Other chartists saw support at around $17.70 in line with a cluster of daily lows over the past week and below there at $17.48 in line with last Friday's low.
On the upside, many chartists saw a stubborn ridge of resistance around the $18.14/15 level in line with a price level that has capped the market over the past few days.
On the gas oil front, Graham took a neutral stance but saw it falling further before it could puch back up again.

"Look for price to bounce back towards 4164.50 from little if any under $158.50. How this next bounce unfolds towards $164.50 will clarify whether this near bottom is significant or not. It may not be," he said in his energy outlook.
He saw support at $160, $158.00ish, $155ish and $150ish, and resistance at $162, $164.50-75, $165.75, $167.25 and around $170.
